title: Bodycam: Florida Man Allegedly Stabbed Doctor Before High-Speed Chase
description:
A Florida man is behind bars after allegedly leading deputies on a high-speed chase in Vero Beach, Florida on October 4, 2023.  Nicholas Parchesco was taken into custody after the dramatic chase reached speeds of over 130mph, according to the Indian River County Sheriff’s Office. Back-to-back PIT maneuvers were caught on body cameras as the chase ended on I-95. Parchesco was allegedly on the run after stabbing a physician in Palm Beach County, investigators said. He was booked for felony Fleeing and Eluding in Indian River County and later pleaded not guilty. In Palm Beach County, court records show that Parchesco was deemed incompetent to stand trial after a mental evaluation. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
